name: humane-product
review_cadence: after each real project run; at least quarterly

depends_on.impeccable: required base skill, >=4.7.0 (https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable); install with `npx impeccable install`

method_sources: An internal discussion deck on converging AI-built products (not published)
https://impeccable.cn/designing/ (four phases: start, iterate, polish, maintain)

intent.job_to_be_done: Make products built with AI coding agents feel made by people for people: lock intent and scope before UI code, stop unrequested additions, hand visual craft to impeccable, and verify with interaction smell checks and real-task walkthroughs.
target_users: solo product builders and small teams who build with Claude Code or Codex

local: python3 tests/test_smell_scan.py passes on Python 3.9 and 3.12
dom_probe.js checked in a real browser on evals/cases
pilot: one real product built end to end with the skill (planned: business card management tool)

pending_decisions: Thresholds (1 primary button per screen, 3 default filters, 5 steps for the main task) are drafts awaiting team confirmation
Sample size and usable-rate gate for sample-check are undecided
Owner of task tests and rollout plan (open items from the deck)

changes: Open-sourced under MIT; README rewritten for public use
impeccable is now a hard prerequisite: the skill stops and asks the user to install it first
Removed conclusions drawn from internal material and internal project names
Team default style is now marked as an example to replace
First version: SKILL.md flow (intent, fence, sample, build via impeccable, check, ledger) and five red lines
References: impeccable bridge, intent card, fence, sample check, interaction smell list (A-G), task walk, ledger, Japanese business details
Scripts: smell_scan.py (source scan) and dom_probe.js (in-page counts and text findings)
Evals: 3 before/after fixture pairs, 18 trigger cases, 20 unit tests
